name: Shoko MPC-HC
overview: Play episodes in MPC-HC directly from the Shoko Web UI. Includes one-time Windows link-handler setup.

releases.release_notes: Choose which TV to cast to from a menu beside the TV button: the Wi-Fi Direct display or a Google Cast device found by the cast agent on your network. The choice is remembered per browser. Needs the matching cast agent update. No Windows Setup update needed.
